scope: Unchanged original checked/unchecked UTF16-to-byte wrappers, byte ownership templates/C wrappers, core factory descriptors, UTF8/single-byte converters and helper/classification dependencies. Primitive SAL types, original atomic macros and malloc/free allocator globals. Full registry service traps and is never invoked. Nonfatal diagnostic/log macros omitted. Real replaceable allocator hooks observe sizes, identities and frees; ASan/UBSan enabled. Core encodings only; not full SAL ABI, OSL or Writer parity.
